blockingIssues.affected: Left-side text background and overall visual hierarchy
blockingIssues.impact: The equipment and window compete with the copy, particularly at 360px. This materially replaces the concept's quiet, high-contrast text column with a busy photographic background and exposes an unintended irregular black strip along the left edge.
blockingIssues.message: Left-side text background and overall visual hierarchy: The equipment and window compete with the copy, particularly at 360px. This materially replaces the concept's quiet, high-contrast text column with a busy photographic background and exposes an unintended irregular black strip along the left edge. Fix: Restore left-to-right darkening behind the text, keeping the right-side subject visible. Use a code-owned gradient rather than regenerating the photograph.

warnings.impact: The headline remains readable and retains its hierarchy, but its compact, oversized visual character is somewhat weakened.
warnings.message: Primary and secondary headline typography: The headline remains readable and retains its hierarchy, but its compact, oversized visual character is somewhat weakened. Fix: Modestly increase headline sizes while tightening letter spacing to retain the existing text-column width.
